## About

Sachin Yadav (Binary Sphere) is a software engineer and computer science engineering student who builds intelligent systems, deep neural vision models, and full-stack web architectures. His work spans computer vision for satellite meteorology (Cyclone Pattern Identifier), spatial-temporal forecasting (Demand Forecast), collaborative developer platforms (Bright Code), geospatial telemetry systems (JalDrishti), and creative platforms (Creatify).

He approaches engineering from first principles: understanding algorithmic fundamentals, data structures, and mathematical foundations before scaling to production architectures.

## Selected Projects

- [Bright Code](https://bright-code-ruby.vercel.app/): real-time collaborative coding platform with live sync & interactive workspaces. Built with React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Socket.io, and Monaco Editor. Source: https://github.com/SachinYadav2446/BrightCode
- [JalDrishti](https://github.com/SachinYadav2446/JalDrishti): automated telemetric groundwater resource evaluation platform analyzing Digital Water Level Recorder (DWLR) sensors across India-WRIS for the Ministry of Jal Shakti. Ingests 2.4M+ daily telemetry observations from 3,200+ stations.
- [Cyclone Pattern Identifier](https://github.com/SachinYadav2446/Cyclone-Pattern-Identifier): an AI-based system for detecting and analyzing cyclone patterns from satellite imagery, eye localization, intensity estimation, and forecasting up to 48 hours using PyTorch, ConvNeXt, and ConvLSTM.
- [Demand Forecast](https://github.com/SachinYadav2446/Taxi-Demand-Forecasting-System-): a spatial-temporal urban taxi demand forecasting system using historical NYC taxi trip data with ARIMA and SARIMAX time-series models.
- [Creatify](https://github.com/SachinYadav2446/Creatify): an interactive digital content creation and management engine built with React, TypeScript, and HTML Canvas.
- [Java Basic Projects](https://github.com/SachinYadav2446/Java-basic-Projects): a modular repository of 12 progressive Java applications demonstrating object-oriented programming, data structures, and algorithmic patterns.
- [JavaScript Basic Projects](https://github.com/SachinYadav2446/JS-Projects-Basics-): practical laboratory of vanilla JavaScript web applications and asynchronous DOM engineering.

All projects: https://my-portfolio-ten-beige-59.vercel.app/work
